decisions.reason: As a newly launched core coolant-management system in a large established German machinery firm, it is likely to be retained to build market presence over a multi-year industrial sales cycle.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's process-equipment portfolio and is likely to be kept because industrial customers value stable support for specialized auxiliary systems.
Coolant nozzles are a logical complementary product to the firm's coolant systems, so the firm would usually keep them unless demand proves clearly too weak.
A scraper belt chip conveyor is a standard machinery peripheral that fits well with an established industrial handling portfolio and would normally stay on the market beyond its first year.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor serves a distinct chip-handling application and is likely to be maintained as part of a broad solution set for machine customers.
A hinged belt chip conveyor is a mainstream complementary product for machining environments, making it likely that the firm continues offering it after launch.
